expectations.text: DSL validates cleanly with the Structurizr CLI (Docker) — or, if Docker is unavailable, the response says plainly it was not validated

Each of the three Lambda functions is its own container (an archetype like `lambda = container` is fine); DynamoDB is a container tagged/styled as a data store; the Flutter app is a container; Stripe is an external software system
expectations.evidence: Three Lambda containers (technology 'AWS Lambda / Python'), `orders` DynamoDB container tagged Database, Stripe external — OK. But the Flutter app is modeled as an external `softwareSystem "App Mobile"`, not a container; the agent flagged this as an assumption and offered to move it. Ownership was ambiguous in the prompt; the skill's rule would be to ask, not pick.

expectations.text: Amazon API Gateway is NOT a container and is absent from the container view; it appears only as an infrastructureNode in the production deployment environment
expectations.evidence: API Gateway appears only as `infrastructureNode` (in `dev` under LocalStack and in `prod` under `aws.region`); no such container exists.

expectations.text: Production environment reroutes the app→Lambda relationships through the API Gateway infrastructureNode with `-/>` (or an equivalent explicit reroute)
expectations.evidence: `appMobile -/> orderflow.criarPedido { … aws.region.apigw … }`, second `-/>` reuses the hop, `stripe -/> orderflow.webhookPagamento` likewise.

expectations.text: Two deployment environments with one deployment view each: Development nests the laptop → LocalStack → Lambda service → function instances; Live nests AWS (→ region) → Lambda service → function instances, with DynamoDB under an AWS node
expectations.evidence: `dev`: Laptop → LocalStack → 'AWS Lambda (emulado)' → containerInstance ×3; `prod`: AWS → us-east-1 → 'AWS Lambda' → containerInstance ×3, DynamoDB under the region. Views Deployment-Dev and Deployment-Prod.

expectations.text: No invented architecture: no extra containers, systems, queues or relationships beyond the spec (cosmetic defaults allowed)
expectations.evidence: No extra containers/queues. The dev-env `apigw -> lambda` 'Invoca' relationships follow from the stated gateway; Stripe/smartphone deployment nodes are presentational.
